title: 倒垃圾
summary: Why Taiwanese neighborhoods gather when the music plays.
paragraphs: 在臺灣，倒垃圾是一件很特別的事。
街上沒有大垃圾桶，大家要等垃圾車來。
垃圾車來的時候會放音樂，很多人一聽到音樂就知道垃圾車快到了。
每天晚上，鄰居們都拿著垃圾在路邊等。
垃圾要分類：一般垃圾、資源回收和廚餘都要分開。
第一次在臺灣倒垃圾的時候，我覺得很有意思。
translation: In Taiwan, taking out the trash is something special.
There are no big bins on the street; everyone waits for the garbage truck.
The garbage truck plays music when it comes, so as soon as people hear it they know it's almost here.
Every evening the neighbors wait by the road holding their trash.
Trash has to be sorted: general waste, recycling and food scraps all go separately.
The first time I took out the trash in Taiwan, I found it really interesting.
